messages:
jamie: Heads-up — customer asks for stronger structured output guarantees. Wants JSON Schema enforcement + automatic retry/fallback. Need to scope MVP: how strict should validation be for GA?

mike: We should enumerate enforcement modes: off / soft (warn + repair) / strict (reject + 400). Also decide server-side vs client-side enforcement.

sana: Tech constraints: streaming + early token commit makes hard validation tricky mid-stream. Soft validate post-stream with auto-repair is realistic for MVP. Strict mode can be a separate code path.

katie: UX note — machine-readable errors + suggested fixes are critical. Customers want actionable suggestions, not just "invalid". Avoid breaking streaming UX for builders relying on partial outputs.

oliver: From support: multiple customers are blocked. AcmeHealth explicitly asked for enforced mode + audit logs for compliance.

jamie: Callout: Decision checklist -> 1) enforcement modes + default, 2) retry policy (how many attempts, what signals), 3) model vs deterministic fallback, 4) telemetry & SLA impacts. Any hot takes?

mike: Implementation idea: include `response.validation` metadata and `repair_attempts`. For strict mode, validate before committing response; that adds a small latency hit but keeps contract strong.

sana: For retries, prefer light-touch in-runtime retry (adjust sampling/temp/prompt) rather than full upstream rerun. Also implement deterministic parser fallback for common shape errors.

katie: Docs and examples are a blocker for adoption. Need canonical error payloads. Example suggestion: `{"error":"missing_field","field":"email","suggestion":"provide email or set allow_missing:true"}`. Keep it simple.

jamie: @oliver can you confirm priority customers and whether strict enforcement is mandatory or negotiable?

oliver: Confirmed list: AcmeHealth (mandatory), FinFlow (legal wants strict), EduLabs (blocks prod). All ask for audit logs + attestations.

deploy-bot: created epic PRO-4321: structured-output-validation (owner: jamie).

mike: Proposed roadmap: Sprint 1 -> soft validation + repair + telemetry. Sprint 2 -> strict mode behind enterprise flag + audit logs. Launch criteria: 95% repair success on top-10 schemas, <5% p95 latency regression.

sana: Add automated evals: prompt perturbations, adversarial examples for schema edge cases. Tie regressions to alerts.

jamie: Agree. Quick prioritization poll: 1) soft + repair, 2) strict behind flag (ent-contract), 3) SDK helpers (client-side validators). React with :thumbsup: if this order looks right.

katie: :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup:

oliver: :thumbsup:

sana: :thumbsup:

jamie: Thanks everyone — I'll spin up the spec doc and link the PR to PRO-4321. We should sync with sales on entitlement pricing for strict mode.
